how_to_use: Each shot is one 6–8 s clip for a text-to-video model (Veo 3.1, Kling, Seedance…). Send `prompt` + the global `style` suffix. Use `audio` and `line` for models with native sound. Keep characters consistent by pasting their `look` from `characters`. Real people must never be rendered as likenesses: stand-ins only, real cast replaces them in production.
style: Prestige documentary realism, shot on location in the French Pyrenees (Ariège). Handheld and breathing in the field, locked-off and reverent in sacred places. Natural light, cold indigo-blue shadows, one single warm sodium-gold light source per frame. Anamorphic lens, soft flares, fine film grain, 2.39:1. No text on screen, no logos.

Ludovic.look: man in his forties, navy waxed field jacket, grey beanie, leather notebook and fountain pen, always first on the trail

Idris.look: man in his forties, charcoal merino sweater under a technical shell, thick ring binder with coloured tabs, rugged tablet, glances at a trading app on his phone

Pete.look: Canadian filmmaker, red wool toque, shoulder-rig cinema camera, headphones around neck, often seen only as POV

Cedric.look: young man, wire-rimmed glasses, chalk-dusted fingers, laser rangefinder, graph-paper notebook full of angles

Karl.look: man from Martinique, wide straw hat, linen shirt, beekeeper's smoker and folded veil clipped to his pack, moves slowly and listens

Sophie.look: woman, former tech executive turned shaman, long dark wool coat, hand-painted frame drum, silver rings

Alexa.look: woman, olive parka, pocket audio recorder held out to whoever speaks, small Moleskine, calm and watchful

The Mystic.look: older Portuguese man, white linen, brass pendulum on a chain, speaks rarely

Mike.look: tall German man, oversized expedition backpack, handheld GPS, practical and cheerful

episodes.title: Ascent
episodes.logline: The team gathers in a valley town. The rumour takes shape, and the first witness recants on camera.
beats: COLD OPEN — 3:12 a.m. A shepherd's shaky phone video: a gold light rises over a black ridge, stops dead, holds. Pete (V.O.): “This was sent to us forty days ago.”

A stone village at the head of the valley. The team arrives one by one. In the café, Ludovic unfolds the map; Idris opens his binder on the table: the Nimitz “Tic-Tac” stills, the declassified FLIR frame. “We start with what the Pentagon admits.” His phone lights up: a trade still waiting for its exit.
The barn of the shepherd who sent the video. On camera, he recants: “A drone. Delete it.” Pete lowers the lens. Off-mic, the shepherd adds: “Don't go up after dark.”
Evening. Cedric lays the ridge over a 19th-century cadastral map. Sophie at the window, watching the line of the mountain. Alexa records the room's silence.
Night drive up the switchbacks. Nothing. They turn back, joking. In the background of Pete's last shot, unnoticed by anyone, a gold point winks once on the far ridge.
DOSSIER STING — cut to black. “Dossier 01 · Disclosure, on the record.”

shots.prompt: Vertical-phone-style night footage, heavy noise and compression, a black mountain ridge under stars; a single warm gold light rises slowly from behind the ridge, stops perfectly still and hovers; the hand holding the phone trembles.
shots.camera: handheld phone, shaky, slight digital zoom
shots.audio: wind, a sheep bell far away, a man's breathing
shots.line: PETE (V.O.): This was sent to us forty days ago.

shots.prompt: Golden-hour wide shot of a small stone village at the head of a steep Pyrenean valley, slate roofs, a church tower, a dusty 4x4 arriving on the only road, mountains rising behind.

Inside a rustic village café, morning light through a window; a man in a navy waxed field jacket unfolds a large topographic map; across the table another man in a charcoal sweater opens a thick binder with coloured tabs revealing printed grainy infrared stills of a white oblong object.
shots.camera: handheld, over-the-shoulder, rack focus from map to binder
shots.line: IDRIS: We start with what the Pentagon admits.

shots.prompt: Close-up of a smartphone lying on the café table next to the binder, screen glowing with a stock trading chart and an open position marked 'pending exit'; a hand turns it face down.
Interior of an old stone barn, dusty shafts of light, an elderly shepherd with a weathered face and a flat cap looks away from the camera, uncomfortable, shaking his head.
shots.line: SHEPHERD (in French): A drone. Delete it.

shots.prompt: Same barn, the camera lowers toward the straw floor as if switched off; the shepherd steps closer and speaks quietly, half in shadow.
shots.line: SHEPHERD: Don't go up after dark.

shots.prompt: Night, inside a 4x4 driving down mountain switchbacks, dashboard glow on tired laughing faces; through the rear window, far away on a black ridge, a tiny gold point of light blinks once and is gone; nobody turns around.
shots.camera: locked camera on dashboard facing back

episodes.title: Folklore
episodes.logline: Shepherds, monks and a smuggler's map. Stories that have no business agreeing begin to agree.
beats: COLD OPEN — An old woman by a hearth, speaking Occitan: “My grandmother called them the lanterns of the dead.”
A mountain hut. A smuggler's grandson unrolls a cracked leather map from the 1940s: the old contraband route over the pass, and beside it a small carved symbol, a circle cut by three lines.
The gatehouse of an abbey. A monk speaks of a hermit who “went up to listen” in the 1600s and never came down.

Hotel room, night. Idris pins cases to the wall: the Ariel School children's drawings from Zimbabwe, 1994. Alexa: “You find what you collect. It's the oldest trap in the book.” Idris: “Then tell me why sixty children drew the same thing.” Alexa, after a beat: “John interviewed them. I knew him. He listened. He didn't lead.” It's the one case they agree on.
Cedric freezes on a frame from yesterday: the same three-line symbol is scratched into the lintel of the shepherd's barn.
Three stories, one place. Ludovic circles the pass on the map in red.
DOSSIER STING — “Dossier 02 · The Harvard psychiatrist.”

shots.prompt: Very old woman with deep wrinkles, black shawl, seated by a stone hearth with a low fire, firelight on her face, speaking softly to someone off camera, a cat asleep at her feet.
shots.line: OLD WOMAN (Occitan): My grandmother called them the lanterns of the dead.

shots.prompt: Inside a wooden mountain hut, hands unroll a cracked brown leather map on a rough table; hand-inked trails across mountain passes and a small carved symbol of a circle crossed by three lines.
Stone gatehouse of a Romanesque abbey, a Benedictine monk in a black habit stands in a doorway half in shadow, a woman in an olive parka holds a small audio recorder toward him.
shots.line: MONK (in French): He went up to listen. He never came down.

shots.prompt: Small hotel room at night, a wall covered with pinned printouts, children's crayon drawings of a silver disc and beings with large eyes, a man in a charcoal sweater pins one more as a woman in an olive parka watches, arms crossed.
shots.camera: slow lateral dolly along the wall
shots.line: ALEXA: You find what you collect.

shots.prompt: Close-up of the woman's face softening as she looks at a child's drawing on the wall; lamp light, quiet.
shots.line: ALEXA: John interviewed them. He listened. He didn't lead.

shots.prompt: Laptop screen in a dark room showing a paused video frame of a barn door lintel; a young man in wire glasses zooms in on a scratched symbol, a circle crossed by three lines.
shots.audio: trackpad click, sharp intake of breath
shots.line: CEDRIC: It's the same mark.

shots.prompt: A hand with a red pencil draws a firm circle around a high mountain pass on a topographic map already marked by three different notes.

episodes.title: The Monastery
episodes.logline: A forgotten cloister, and a door that was bricked up for a reason no one will name.
beats: COLD OPEN — A torch beam crawls over a bricked-up doorway in a roofless Romanesque cloister. Above the arch, a carved figure with an elongated head.
The hike in: ruins swallowed by beech forest. Karl stops at the outer wall: wild bees nest everywhere except the north wall. “They won't go near it.”
The bricked door. The parish register, photographed by Alexa: “Walled, 1348, by order of the abbot.” The page that gives the reason has been cut out.

Idris shows a tablet: Elena Danaan's account of meeting a tall being who called himself Enki, “father of your kind”. Ludovic: “That's one woman's bedroom in 2021.” Idris: “Filed as testimony. But look at the head.” Sophie lays her palm on the carving.
Night in the cloister, candles. They vote not to break the wall. Pete slides an endoscope camera through a gap in the mortar.
On the tiny monitor: a chamber floor inlaid with a spiral of stones. Cedric, very quietly: “I've seen this before.”
DOSSIER STING — “Dossier 03 · Stones that remember.”

shots.prompt: Night, a roofless ruined Romanesque cloister, a flashlight beam slowly moving over a bricked-up stone doorway; above the arch a weathered carved figure with an unusually elongated head and large almond eyes.
shots.camera: slow tilt up following the beam

shots.prompt: Daylight in a beech forest, moss-covered monastery ruins; a man in a wide straw hat with a beekeeper's smoker crouches by a wall where wild bees swarm in crevices, then looks at an untouched north wall.
shots.audio: loud bee hum that cuts to silence
shots.line: KARL: They won't go near it.

shots.prompt: Close-up of an ancient parish register on a wooden lectern, Latin handwriting, a clean razor cut where a page has been removed; a woman's hand photographs it with a phone.
In the cloister ruins, a man in a charcoal sweater holds up a tablet toward the carved figure while a woman in a long dark coat with silver rings places her palm flat against the stone carving.
shots.line: IDRIS: Filed as testimony. But look at the head.

shots.prompt: Night, the cloister lit by dozens of candles on the ground, a team of seven sitting in a circle debating quietly; one raises a hand to vote.
A thin endoscope camera cable slides into a gap in old mortar; cut to its small handheld monitor showing a dark hidden chamber whose floor is inlaid with a precise spiral of pale stones.
shots.camera: insert, then monitor POV with fisheye distortion
shots.line: CEDRIC: I've seen this before.

episodes.title: The Pattern
episodes.logline: Cedric finds the same geometry across three megalithic sites that could never have been coordinated.
beats: COLD OPEN — Drone flight over a dolmen, a stone circle and a lone standing stone, kilometres apart.
Cedric at each site with a laser rangefinder, chalk and a compass. The angles match to within a third of a degree. Mike checks the GPS twice.

Idris lays a printout beside Cedric's chart: Sergeant Penniston's notebook from Rendlesham Forest, 1980, pages of ones and zeros. Decoded, it ends: “Disclose. Evolve.” Ludovic: “That's a man with a notebook in 1980.” Idris: “Grade C. Testimony. But it's the second witness, an ocean apart, who worries me.”
Karl, quietly: the old transhumance route the shepherds walk every summer follows the same line. “The sheep knew first.”
Night. Cedric extends the three lines on his tablet. They meet at the pass circled in red.
Cedric: “It's not a map. It's an address.”
DOSSIER STING — “Dossier 04 · The Janus Universe.”

shots.prompt: Aerial drone shot gliding over a megalithic dolmen in a high mountain meadow at dawn, then across valleys toward a distant stone circle, mist in the valleys.

A young man with wire-rimmed glasses kneels beside a standing stone, aiming a laser rangefinder across the valley, a tall man with a large backpack reads a handheld GPS beside him, graph paper covered in angles.
shots.camera: handheld medium, rack focus between devices
shots.line: CEDRIC: Point three of a degree. Again.

shots.prompt: On a flat rock, a graph-paper chart of angles next to a printed photocopy of a handwritten notebook page filled with ones and zeros; a hand slides the printout into place.
shots.line: IDRIS: Disclose. Evolve.

shots.prompt: A man in a navy field jacket shakes his head, half smiling, sceptical, mountains behind him.
shots.line: LUDOVIC: That's a man with a notebook in 1980.

shots.prompt: A flock of sheep with bells moving in a single line along an ancient path across a ridge at golden hour; a man in a straw hat watches them, smiling slightly.
shots.line: KARL: The sheep knew first.

shots.prompt: Night, a glowing tablet screen held in the dark showing a topographic map where three straight gold lines extend from three points and converge on one mountain pass; the young man's face lit from below.
shots.camera: close, slow push to the screen
shots.line: CEDRIC: It's not a map. It's an address.

episodes.title: The Ceremony
episodes.logline: To see differently, the team agrees to perceive differently. Not everyone comes back the same.
beats: COLD OPEN — A fire inside a ring of stones at night. A frame drum, slow as a heartbeat.
The argument: who takes part. Pete refuses: “Someone stays sober behind the lens.” Alexa will sit out and record.
Sophie leads breathwork and drumming. Faces in firelight. The mystic swings his pendulum, then stops it.
Idris lies on his back and tries what his sources describe: leaving the body. Subjective shot: rising slowly above the circle, his own body below, then drifting up the dark ridge toward a gold glow.

Dawn. Alexa holds the recorder to Idris. He describes a curved stone shelter on the ridge none of them has seen. Then he draws it: a spiral floor. Cedric puts his endoscope still beside it. They match.
The mystic has not spoken since the drum stopped.
DOSSIER STING — “Dossier 05 · Leaving the body.”

shots.prompt: Night, a fire burning inside a ring of ancient standing stones on a mountain plateau, sparks rising into a sky full of stars, a hand-painted frame drum in the foreground.
A man in a red wool toque holding a shoulder-rig cinema camera shakes his head firmly, firelight on his face, others around the fire out of focus.
shots.line: PETE: Someone stays sober behind the lens.

shots.prompt: A woman in a long dark coat with silver rings beats a frame drum, eyes closed, leading a circle of people breathing deeply in unison around a fire; an older man in white linen holds a still brass pendulum.

Subjective out-of-body shot: the camera rises slowly and weightlessly straight up from a man lying on his back by a fire, the circle of people shrinking below, then drifts toward a dark mountain ridge where a faint gold glow pulses.
shots.camera: smooth vertical crane up into a floating glide, slight dreamlike blur
shots.audio: drum fading to deep silence, a high soft tone

shots.prompt: Blue dawn, embers of the fire, a man in a charcoal sweater sketches a spiral of stones in a notebook, a woman in an olive parka holds a small audio recorder toward him; a young man places a printed photo of a spiral floor beside the sketch.
shots.camera: handheld, insert to the two images side by side
shots.line: IDRIS: It was round. And the floor turned.

shots.prompt: An older man in white linen sits alone on a rock at dawn, wrapped in a blanket, staring at the ridge, completely silent.

episodes.title: Coincidence
episodes.logline: The lights return. The instruments disagree with the eyes. Pete stops narrating.
beats: COLD OPEN — Timelapse of the ridge at night. Stars wheel. Then, between frames, three gold points.
The team on the ridge with instruments: magnetometer, thermal camera, radio scanner. Three gold lights in a triangle. One drops several hundred metres in an instant and stops.
The eyes see it. The thermal camera sees nothing. The magnetometer needle pins. The radio fills with a slow, regular pulse.
Then they're walking back to the car. Ludovic's watch says 23:47. Idris's says 23:31. The camera clock says 00:04. Seventeen minutes no one remembers.
Idris, quietly: “Time dilation. Or we're exhausted.” He files it anyway. On his phone: his trade exit triggered at 23:38, during the minutes he can't account for.
Pete keeps rolling, but he has stopped narrating. Last shot: Pete alone in the car, saying nothing.
DOSSIER STING — “Dossier 06 · How would they fly?”

shots.prompt: Night timelapse of a mountain ridge under a wheeling starfield, then three small warm gold points of light appear in a triangle above the ridge and hold perfectly still while the stars keep moving.

Silhouettes of seven people on a mountain ridge at night with headlamps off, looking up; above them three gold lights in a triangle; one light suddenly drops straight down hundreds of metres in an instant and stops dead.
Screen of a handheld thermal camera showing the people as bright white shapes and an empty dark sky where the lights should be; next to it a magnetometer needle pinned to the right.
shots.audio: radio scanner emitting a slow regular pulse
shots.line: MIKE: Thermal's got nothing.

shots.prompt: Close-up of three wrists and a camera display held side by side under a headlamp: analog watch at 23:47, digital watch at 23:31, camera timecode at 00:04.
shots.line: LUDOVIC: Where did seventeen minutes go?

shots.prompt: A man in a charcoal sweater looks at his phone in the dark: a notification that a trade has closed at 23:38; his face unreadable.
shots.line: IDRIS: Time dilation. Or we're exhausted.

shots.prompt: Inside a parked 4x4 at night, a man in a red wool toque sits in the passenger seat holding his camera in his lap, still recording, staring forward, saying nothing.
shots.audio: engine ticking as it cools, silence

episodes.title: The Watchers
episodes.logline: Someone has been here before them. And someone, it turns out, does not want the base found.
beats: COLD OPEN — A white van with roof antennas parked in the village square. Through its window, a long lens photographs the team's 4x4.
On the way to the pass: fresh survey stakes, a cut fence, and an abandoned camp from decades ago: rusted instrument cases, a 1970s tape recorder, a logbook with entries that stop mid-sentence.
Back at the hotel, Idris's binder has been opened. One section is gone: the Eisenhower 1954 file, his weakest, which he marks as testimony only. “They took the weakest file. Why that one?”
A polite man in a fleece, “regional water authority”, tells them the pass is closed: rockfall. He knows their names.
The team splits. Alexa wants to stop. Ludovic wants to go. Idris abstains, then doesn't. They vote.
Night. They go anyway, single file on the smugglers' path from Episode 2.
DOSSIER STING — “Dossier 07 · What the state knows.”

shots.prompt: Village square at dusk, a plain white van with roof antennas parked under a plane tree; through its side window a long telephoto lens slowly turns toward a dusty 4x4.
shots.camera: long lens from across the square

shots.prompt: Mountain slope, an abandoned old campsite half buried in grass: rusted metal instrument cases, a vintage reel-to-reel tape recorder, a weathered logbook; a woman in an olive parka lifts the logbook carefully.
Hotel room, a thick binder with coloured tabs lies open on a bed; a gap where a whole section has been pulled out, torn ring holes visible; a man stares at it.
shots.line: IDRIS: They took the weakest file. Why that one?

shots.prompt: Hotel doorway, a polite middle-aged man in a grey fleece with a clipboard smiles and speaks to the team, too calm; behind him a corridor.
shots.camera: handheld, shot from inside the room
shots.line: MAN: The pass is closed. Rockfall. Good evening, Ludovic.

shots.prompt: Seven people around a hotel table at night, a map in the middle with a red circle, tense faces; hands rise one by one to vote.
Night, a line of seven small headlamps climbing single file up a narrow mountain path under a moonless sky, seen from far below.

episodes.title: Contact
episodes.logline: They reach the place the stories pointed to all along. The question they came with is no longer the question.
beats: COLD OPEN — The last climb before dawn. Breath steaming in headlamp beams.
The pass: a natural stone amphitheatre. In its centre, a round dry-stone shelter. Inside, the spiral floor from the endoscope and from Idris's drawing.
Everything goes quiet. Instruments read zero. Even the wind stops.
A single gold light rises slowly from below the ridge and holds at eye level, a hundred metres away. Nothing dramatic happens. It simply stays, as if it were the one observing.
Each face. Idris lowers his tablet and asks out loud: “Are we interesting enough for you to bother?” Sophie: “Wrong question.” Alexa keeps recording.
The light drifts away slowly, south. Pete's battery dies on the move. The last images come from Cedric's phone.
END CARD — new coordinates appear: 77°S. Season 2 · Antarctica.
DOSSIER STING — “Dossier 08 · If it happened tomorrow.”

shots.prompt: Pre-dawn, a group climbing a steep rocky slope, headlamp beams cutting through cold mist, breath steaming, the sky turning deep blue.
Wide shot of a natural stone amphitheatre high in the mountains at blue hour, in its centre a small round dry-stone shelter; the team stops at the rim.
shots.camera: slow crane down over their shoulders

shots.prompt: Inside the dry-stone shelter, a headlamp reveals a floor inlaid with a perfect spiral of pale stones; a hand places a pencil sketch of the same spiral next to it.

From below the ridge a single soft gold sphere of light rises slowly and stops at eye level about a hundred metres away, perfectly still, faintly illuminating the faces of seven people standing in a line.
shots.camera: wide, locked-off, then very slow push

shots.prompt: Close-up of a man in a charcoal sweater lowering a tablet, gold light on his face, speaking softly toward the light; beside him a woman with a frame drum shakes her head gently.
shots.line: IDRIS: Are we interesting enough for you to bother? — SOPHIE: Wrong question.

shots.prompt: The gold light drifts slowly away to the south over endless mountain ridges at sunrise; the image switches to vertical phone footage, slightly shaky, then cuts to black.
shots.camera: cinema camera to phone POV handover
